body: ## Advance_on_start not fixed this issue. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ec9cd7c0-a6b2-454d-a25e-4c0c055a2ede) It only works for first time translating to the idle_turn state. But next time, the bug comes back. ## Change the AnimationTree CallBackMode to Physics doesn't work either. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e187653d-f343-4d06-95b7-4607de83ae30) It brings a new bug, another type twitch . ## Try CallbackMethod Manual ```gdscript func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void: var sm = animation_tree["parameters/locomotion/playback"] as AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up"): animation_tree.active = true last_tick = Time.get_ticks_msec() printt("flip") print_timestamp() flip_h() print("after_flip") print_timestamp() print("begin_play_idle_turn") sm.travel("idle_turn") if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_down"): animation_tree.active = false last_tick = Time.get_ticks_msec() printt("flip") print_timestamp() flip_h() print("after_flip") print_timestamp() print("begin_play_idle_turn") animation_player.play("idle_turn") await animation_player.animation_finished animation_player.play("idle") move_and_slide() ## Try set CallbackMode Manual and call advance in _physic_process animation_tree.advance(delta) ``` ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb2b423d-d6b8-4b8d-8238-853dbf0a298b) It twitches much harder. ## disable advance_on_start and manual advance ```gdscript func _physics_process(delta): ... move_and_slide() animation_tree.advance(delta) ``` ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/18510514-c8ce-4bbc-9492-c1ac5cbb2e64) It twitches at beginning, but it works fine after translating once. ## Reddit people give another way to fix it. https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/u3iq47/why_is_there_a_one_frame_lag_in_animation_tree/ You don't need to change CallbackMode or set advance_on_start. Just extra call animation_tree.advance(0) every physics. ```gdscript func _physics_process(delta): ... move_and_slide() ## just call advance(0) every physics animation_tree.advance(0) ``` ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9fc55ec-d2c6-4d7f-b703-5fddb315e276) It works ! ## Summary I don't know why. But I guess. advance_on_start is designed to solve this problem, but advance_on_start only takes effect once when entering this state for the first time, and it has no effect when entering this state again afterwards. Manually supplementing the call to animation_tree.advance(0) in _physics_process is equivalent to forcing an advance once per physics frame. Since delta is 0, it has no impact on the animation progress, but it miraculously remedies the subsequent failure of advance_on_start. @TokageItLab
It is right that `advance_on_start` was implemented to resolve this issue. If its 2nd and later processing is incorrect, I have no objection to fixing it.

Another bug.
`advance_on_start` may not process the CallMethodTrack's key which is on 0 frame. But it didn't happen while call animation_tree.advance(0) in `_physics_process`.
